name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd
title: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd - 500570 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 India volumes of 6.42 lakh (+15%) with Q4 above 2 lakh, but commodity headwind of 5-6% of revenue is largely unpassed and JLR cash breakeven still high at ~GBP2.2bn FY26 cash loss.

triggers.label: Commodity headwind 5-6% of revenue
triggers.quote: The impact has been somewhere between 5% to 6% of revenue, definitely upwards of 5%.

triggers.label: Cost-out 2% of revenue offset commodities
triggers.quote: the 2% cost reductions that we have done has completely gone to absorb the commodity increases

triggers.label: India dealer inventory ~20 days
triggers.quote: we are right now at about 20 day level

triggers.label: Q4 volume above 2 lakh, +37% YoY
triggers.quote: Q4 saw record volumes exceeding 2 lakh units for the first time with 37% growth year-on-year.

triggers.label: JLR breakeven target 300k via GBP1.7bn savings
triggers.quote: Together, we're targeting GBP1.7 billion of savings over two years to bring our breakeven volume back down towards 300,000 units a year.

guidance.quote: Together, we're targeting GBP1.7 billion of savings over two years to bring our breakeven volume back down towards 300,000 units a year.
I would still bet that industry will grow somewhere around 10%
we are targeting anywhere between 70% to 100% kind of a growth
Hopefully, we'll start ramping up further beyond 10,000 from this month onwards.

red_flags.label: JLR FY26 cash loss and warranty cost pressure
red_flags.quote: our warranty costs remained stubborn despite the focus that we have in this area

red_flags.label: Unpassed commodity inflation
red_flags.quote: we have not been able to pass on this to the market

evasions.quote: We'll give financial guidance at Investor Day in June.
